table.name: TLGNU_USER_SHIPTO_ACC
table.description: Access Control/Data restriction table. Defines the Ship-Tos (tlgns_sap_bp with bp_is_shipto=1) a user has access to.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The Shipto for which access is granted. Technical hint: This must be the SAP shipto (tlgns_sap_bp), unless we would create a Logon shipto (tlgnc_shipto) for each shipto.

column.name: USER_SOLDTO_BP_ACC_ID
column.description: FK tlgnu_user_soldto_bp_acc. With this constraint, we enforce, that any shipto restriction requires that its soldto_bp is also restricted. I.e. you cannot create a shipto restriction, if there is not already a restriction on the respective soldto_bp.
